rows.footnotes: [1967]- i.e., the horses bearing riders as they race to attack the enemy.

rows.translation: (2) And the producers of sparks [when] striking[1968]
rows.footnotes: [1968]- Their hoofs while galloping over rocky terrain.

rows.translation: (5) Arriving thereby in the center[1970] collectively,
rows.footnotes: [1970]- i.e., penetrating into the enemy ranks during a surprise attack.

rows.translation: (6) Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
(7) And indeed, he is to that a witness.[1971]
rows.footnotes: [1971]- Through his speech and his actions.

rows.translation: (8) And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
(9) But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
(10) And that within the breasts is obtained,[1972]
rows.footnotes: [1972]- i.e., when all secrets are made known.

rows.translation: (11) Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.[1973]
rows.footnotes: [1973]- Fully acquainted and familiar with everything about each one of them.
